sql: select strategy, count(*) trades_12h, count(*) filter (where status='open') still_open, count(*) filter (where status<>'open') closed, round(sum(coalesce(pnl,0))::numeric,2) pnl_12h, max(created_at) last_trade from paper_trades where created_at > now() - interval '12 hours' group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 30
